 Published:  November 20, 2026 at 12:31 AM Tags:  brevard , flood A flash flood warning is in effect for Brevard county. Meteorologist Jonathan Kegges is tracking heavy rain moving through parts of Central Florida.
 Intense rain is expected to continue through Friday with additional flash flooding likely. Click here for details
